sections.skill: Compare two versions with the same tests and written criteria

questions.domain: Work: measuring how well AI works
questions.prompt: What makes a comparison fair?

choices.text: Same tests and criteria written beforehand

questions.correct_answer: Same tests and criteria written beforehand
questions.intro: To compare two versions fairly, such as two tools, two prompts or an old and a new model, use the SAME TESTS and WRITTEN CRITERIA decided BEFORE you look at results. Change ONE thing at a time, so you know what caused any difference. Run both on every example, record results side by side, and count. Watch for small samples: with 5 examples, one lucky answer changes the score a lot. If you can, hide which version produced which answer when judging quality, so your expectations do not tip the scales.

sections.skill: Compare version testing with a fair taste test

questions.domain: Work: measuring how well AI works
questions.prompt: Why use the same oven for both recipes?

choices.text: Because ovens can only be used once each day and must be shared by both recipes

questions.correct_answer: So only the recipe differs
questions.intro: To find out which of two cookie recipes is better, you bake both with the SAME oven, the SAME temperature and the SAME tasters, and decide beforehand what "better" means: taste, texture, appearance. Tasters do not know which is which. If you changed the recipe AND the oven at once, you would not know which change mattered. Comparing AI versions works the same way.

sections.title: Apply it

questions.domain: Work: measuring how well AI works
questions.prompt: What is a regression?

choices.text: Something that used to work now fails
A new feature that works better

questions.correct_answer: Something that used to work now fails
questions.intro: Unfair comparisons are common. Testing the new version on easy examples and the old on hard ones, changing the prompt and the model at the same time, or judging by the one impressive answer you remember all mislead. Writing criteria after seeing results lets you pick the ones that favor your preference. Also check whether the new version fixed some problems but broke others that used to work, called a REGRESSION.
